name: skill-quality
description: Skill-authoring QA tooling (skill-quality:check): a static contract checker running thirty deterministic checks over a Claude Code skill (frontmatter, invocation mode, description, listing cap, trigger keywords, line caps, broken refs, markdownlint, gotchas, evals), a shared skill-listing budget reporter, a schema check with an eval-quality lint for legacy per-skill evals.json files (new eval cases use the plugin suite format that /evals:validate checks), and a measure-invocation harness that scores description auto-invocation probes on train and validation splits.

skills_root.title: Skills directory
skills_root.description: Directory holding your skills (each a subdirectory with a SKILL.md). When unset, resolves to .claude/skills under the project root. Set this only when your skills live elsewhere.
